meta.title: UCX: Three Gated Workflows, Run in Order

views.label: Read-only first
views.note: Assessment scans and reports. Nothing in the source workspace is modified.

views.label: Groups before tables
views.note: Group migration is a prerequisite for Unity Catalog grants to behave correctly at all.

views.label: Table upgrade
views.note: SYNC, CTAS, or DEEP CLONE, chosen per table by the assessment, not by default.

cards.title: Non-destructive by design
items: Assessment scans Hive tables, DBFS mounts, workspace-local groups, and incompatible cluster configs
Findings land as Delta tables plus a dashboard in a dedicated assessment workspace, not the one being scanned
Export the readiness report before touching any source object

cards.title: Two gated workflows, not one script
items: Group migration converts workspace-local groups and re-points cluster/job/notebook ACLs at the account-level group
migrate-groups runs as a deployed Databricks Job — monitor and repair-run it, there is no direct run flag
Review the assessment output between workflows; don't run them back-to-back

cards.title: UCX upgrades in place, it doesn't cross clouds
items: It does not create target-cloud storage credentials or provision a metastore in a different account
A cross-cloud move still needs Unity Catalog strategy, metastore migration, and per-cloud Terraform
Skip UCX entirely if the source is already fully on Unity Catalog with account-level groups
